purpose: Plan how Brain should use the broader LangGraph/LangSmith ecosystem without overcommitting

layers.name: LangGraph OSS Runtime
layers.value_to_brain: Provides durable execution, structured graph nodes, stateful workflows, and future human-in-the-loop hooks.
layers.risk: Graph complexity; package version drift; missing production methods.
layers.prerequisite: All GATE-01 production methods implemented and tested.

layers.name: LangSmith Observability / local equivalent
layers.current_status: Not integrated. Local TraceStore already provides per-run traces.
layers.value_to_brain: Could provide trace export, run metrics, failure clustering, and evaluation datasets.
layers.risk: Cloud dependency; data leakage of source code or user prompts; cost.
layers.prerequisite: Local runtime stable; explicit operator approval for any cloud tracing.
layers.next_front_required: Optional future front to evaluate local LangSmith self-hosting or trace export adapter.

layers.name: LangGraph Platform / deployment concept
layers.value_to_brain: Managed deployments, scaling, and persisted checkpoints in production.
layers.risk: External cloud by default violates self-hosted preference; cost; vendor lock-in.
layers.prerequisite: Local runtime is default-stable and all gates pass.
layers.next_front_required: Separate evaluation front only after local default promotion succeeds.

layers.name: Deep Agents / sub-agent harness concept
layers.current_status: Conceptual. Single-agent governance must be stable first.
layers.value_to_brain: Future multi-agent roles: Research Agent, Memory Curator, Code Auditor, Governance Auditor, CEI/FDOT Knowledge Agent, Trading Research Agent, Strategy Risk Auditor.
layers.risk: Swarms before single-agent governance is stable create uncontrolled action surface.
layers.prerequisite: LangGraph is default backend; tool governance, memory boundaries, and human gates are proven.

layers.name: MCP / tools
layers.current_status: ToolGatewayV2 exists; SUPPORTED_READ_TOOLS whitelist in LangGraph runtime.
layers.value_to_brain: Safe tool registry enables read-only, dry-run, approval-required, and forbidden tool classes.
layers.risk: Broker/trading execution tools must never be added without separate risk-governance front.
layers.prerequisite: Governance and human gate plan accepted.

layers.name: Evaluation
layers.current_status: Smoke tests exist; no formal LangGraph-vs-Native regression suite.
layers.value_to_brain: Scenario tests, golden prompts, regression journals, trace comparison, pass/fail rubric.
layers.risk: Hidden regressions if default promotion happens without comparable evaluation.
